Subject: Re: Commercial plan: pricing lanes, min commit split & invoice cadence

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the demo last week. Finance and procurement asked me to share BrightCo's desired invoicing cadence and a proposed split of the minimum commit across Q4/Q1 to match budget windows. High level:

- Target: $450k annual commit starting Sep 1 2028.
- Prefer split: 40% up front (activation), 30% at end of Q4, 30% at end of Q1.
- Preferred payment terms: Net 45.
- Need tax residency confirmation and W-9 (US entity).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the split above and issue an initial invoice with PO #BRGT-PO-887? Also please attach your order form so we can run to legal.

Appreciate quick turnaround — procurement wants order form in next 72 hours.

Thanks,
Mark
Procurement Manager
BrightCo

Subject: Re: Commercial plan: pricing lanes, min commit split & invoice cadence

Hi Mark —

Thanks — this is helpful and should be doable with a couple of clarifications from your legal/finance team. Quick answers up front:

- We can structure the minimum commit as a three-tranche staircase matching your suggested 40/30/30 split.
- We typically issue an activation invoice for the up-front tranche on signature (invoice 1 = 40%). Subsequent invoices can be scheduled on milestone dates (end-of-quarter).
- Standard Redwood default payment terms are Net 30. Sales can approve Net 45 for enterprise deals but will need a brief credit review and Exec approval if legal requests any payment security.
- We need tax documentation (W-9) and a signed order form; if BrightCo is VAT-exempt state-side, confirm the tax ID and entity to route invoices to the right business unit.

I attached a draft order form that maps the pricing lanes and the staircase split; it also includes two invoicing options: (A) Activation + two milestone invoices; (B) Activation + monthly amortization across first 6 months (for cashflow smoothing). Please review and tell us which option you prefer.

Action items I propose:
- BrightCo: send W-9 + PO (you've referenced BRGT-PO-887, confirm if that's final).
- BrightCo legal: confirm acceptance of Net 45 or propose Net 30 if Net 45 is not acceptable.
- Redwood: Karthik and Ben will review MSA cross-references and any special tax clauses.

I've attached: proposed-orderform-20280729.xlsx (pricing lanes + schedule) and tax-evidence-template.pdf.

If you want, we can lock the activation invoice upon signature and route the subsequent invoices per your preferred milestone dates.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial plan: pricing lanes, min commit split & invoice cadence

Mark / Kimberly —

Quick legal review and redline summary after scanning the proposed OF: please see attached OF-redline-v2.docx for inline comments. High level notes:

1) Net terms: Redwood standard is Net 30. We can make Net 45 subject to (i) credit check completion and (ii) a one-time activation invoice paid within 30 days to reduce risk. If BrightCo insists on Net 45 across all invoices, legal requests a shortfall remedy clause (e.g., reserves on future credits) — would prefer to avoid escrow/retainer.

2) Taxes: We need entity-level tax residency confirmation. If BrightCo is US tax-exempt for state taxes, please provide state exemption certificate + Federal EIN. For international subsidiaries, we need VAT/Tax ID and whether reverse-charge applies.

3) Invoicing: Recommended practical approach: issue Invoice 1 (40%) on signature, Invoice 2 (30%) at EOY milestone with 15-day grace for dispute, Invoice 3 (30%) at EOY+Q1 close. Include a single payment instruction block that points to Redwood's AP portal to avoid wire confusion.

4) Minimum commit & proration: define proration for partial activation days in the OF (section 2.1) and include an explicit non-refundable activation fraction for the 40% tranche to cover onboarding.

5) Entity mapping: If BrightCo routes invoices to a different legal entity than the contracting party, we need a signed intercompany addendum or PO that references the billing entity.

6) PO flow: confirm PO number and include it in the invoice header; procurement should ensure PO references "Redwood Inference" and the entity name on the W-9.

If BrightCo is fine with (i) activation invoice due Net 30 and (ii) subsequent invoices Net 45, we can accommodate that structure but need it called out in the order form and an internal credit approval ticket.

I'll be OOO tomorrow afternoon but available this afternoon for a 30-min legal-commercial sync if you'd like to hop on a quick call.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(Attachment stub: OF-redline-v2.docx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial plan: pricing lanes, min commit split & invoice cadence

Thanks team — short confirmation from Sales:

- We're OK to accept Net 45 on the two milestone invoices if BrightCo agrees to pay the activation invoice on Net 30 upon signature. That gives us the up-front cash protection Karthik asked for.
- We accept the 40/30/30 staircase.
- If Finance wants amortization option (B), we can model that for accounting but prefer milestone billing by default.

Mark — if you can confirm PO BRGT-PO-887 and send W-9 by EOD Wednesday we will: (1) finalize OF with Karthik's redlines, (2) route for Exec approval for the Net 45 concession, and (3) issue activation invoice upon signature.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to close this out — suggest 10:30am PT Wed if that works.
